gloss_en: Raglin/raglayim — the feet/legs, the lowest limbs of the body (Aramaic raglin), used as a homiletic bechina for the lowest levels: speech, livelihood/money, the rebukers of the generation, the wife/nukva, standing in Torah and prayer, dancing, and the sefirot Netzach-and-Hod

outliers.actual_gloss_en: Regalim — the pilgrimage festivals (regel = appointed time/occasion, as in שלוש רגלים), identified with 'binah la-itim' (understanding of times)
outliers.reason: Vocalized רְגָלִים and equated with בינה לעתים (times/festivals), i.e. regel in the sense of 'occasion/festival' (cf. Num 22:28 'שלוש רגלים'), not the body-limb sense raglayim/raglin carried by all other occurrences
